title: Light and dark UI design tokens

claims.text: The :root and .theme-light block defines shared semantic tokens for background, surface, text, link, error and success colors with light values.
The .theme-dark block overrides the same semantic tokens with dark color-scheme values and dark shadow, keeping token names unchanged.
Shared typography, spacing and radius tokens (--lin-font-ui, --lin-font-mono, --lin-space-*, --lin-radius-*, --lin-type-*) are defined once and reused across every theme.

decision.rule: Change here when semantic colors, typography, spacing or radius tokens for the light and dark themes need to change.
decision.failure: A theme renders with wrong or unreadable colors, a token is undefined, or component spacing and type sizes drift from the shared scale.
